fine_trace.code: unsigned const size = find_LOAD_gap(phdr, j, u_phnum);
fine_trace.note: The PT_LOAD gap length is derived from attacker-controlled ELF program headers and is later used as the 32-bit needle for recovery inside peek_arr.
The file-controlled 64-byte recovery window is copied into the stack buffer that is later searched for the gap-size word.
The scan finds the little-endian encoding of size near the end of peek_arr, yielding a nonnegative offset that does not leave room for a full b_info.
The guard rejects only a missing match and omits the required bounds check that boff plus sizeof(b_info) fits within sizeof(peek_arr).
The unchecked tail offset is reinterpreted as a b_info pointer even though the resulting structure extends past the stack buffer.
The 4-byte read of bp->sz_cpr crosses the end of peek_arr when bp points near the end of the 64-byte stack buffer.
